purpose: Map questions scientists currently argue about onto FSOT folds: already gated, preregistered, next-layer expansion, refused, or sibling-owned.

questions.question: Can we predict the time and place of the next large earthquake?
questions.community: No deterministic short-term prediction; probabilistic hazard (Gutenberg–Richter, ETAS, CSE).
questions.fsot: Not a clock-time hypocenter. Dated *windows* on live pressure cells (PRED-064): location + 7-day POOF window, scored after valid_to.

questions.question: Why is the global b-value ≈ 1?
questions.community: Empirical Gutenberg–Richter; regional 0.6–1.4; physical origin debated.
questions.fsot: b = φ − 1/φ = 1. Acoustic counting in the crustal fluid. PRED-056 literature band 0.90–1.10.

questions.question: Are slow slip and fast earthquakes two different physics?
questions.community: Moment-duration scaling linear vs cubic still contested; no unifying constitutive law.
questions.fsot: One T3 valve: POOF = fast, SUCTION = slow. Viscosity continuum. PRED-057.

questions.question: Lab acoustics vs Earth PREM — same wave?
questions.community: Often siloed (ultrasonics vs global Earth models).
questions.fsot: Already residual-gated: mafic/lid vp/vs from ν=D_atomic/25. PRED-061.

questions.question: Can we predict eruption onset dates?
questions.community: Unrest monitoring (InSAR, SO2, seismicity); no reliable date forecast.
questions.fsot: Not a clock-time. Volcanic USGS cells get 14-day POOF windows (PRED-064) plus GVP residual hold PRED-058.

questions.question: What will the solar-cycle amplitude be (one SSN)?
questions.community: Cycle 25 panel said ~115 (Jul 2025); cycle ran stronger. Amplitude remains hard.
questions.fsot: Not one number — quiet vs storm sectors of one valve (same grammar as H0). PRED-062. Do not relock Cycle 25 SSN after the peak.

questions.question: Can Kp/Dst be classified from first principles rather than decoupled heuristics?
questions.community: Empirical Kp/Dst thresholds; coupling to F10.7 / IMF is statistical.
questions.fsot: Already green classifiers + PRED-007 ionospheric β. Hold PRED-059 on SWPC refresh.

questions.question: Is ENSO a separate oscillator from the rest of the fluid?
questions.community: Coupled ocean-atmosphere modes; S2S skill is the operational frontier.
questions.fsot: κ(Oceanography, Atmospheric_Physics, Fluid_Dynamics). Residual holds PRED-060/063/054. Not an ECMWF-beating week-3 forecast.

questions.question: Can FSOT beat numerical weather prediction at S2S?
questions.community: S2S is an active WMO/NOAA program; skill drops after ~2 weeks.
questions.fsot: Not claimed. Class residuals on NDBC/NCEI only. Individual storm tracks are T1 look, not a new H0.

questions.question: Why do Planck and SH0ES disagree on H0?
questions.community: Hubble tension; new physics vs systematics.
questions.fsot: Solved as sectors of one fluid, not two cosmologies. Bridge 70.75 ≠ JWST Perfect Host 73.49 (local ladder). Fair bridge compare is CCHP TRGB / dual-anchor. See docs/OBJECT_SCORING.md.

questions.question: S8 tension (Planck vs weak lensing)?
questions.community: Open. Euclid DR1 is the next independent drop.
questions.fsot: PRED-002 / PRED-042 lock 0.805. DES Y6 alone 0.789 is a tension row; joint DES+CMB+low-z 0.806 is the fair compare (arXiv:2601.14559). Euclid DR1 Nov 2026 still awaiting. CLOE is synthetic.

questions.question: Cosmological lithium problem?
questions.community: BBN vs halo-star Li gap ~factor 3.
questions.fsot: PRED-005 factor 2.85. Nuclear orifice already dual-routed (PRED nuclear levels).

questions.question: Muon g-2 excess?
questions.community: Experiment vs lattice SM still moving.
questions.fsot: PRED-004/050 same-sign lock. Do not retune after lattice papers.

questions.question: Is m_H an input or a prediction?
questions.community: SM input; measured ~125.25 GeV.
questions.fsot: PRED-049 hold vs next PDG combination at 0.5%.

questions.question: Can sequence-only models beat measured-map folds?
questions.community: AlphaFold-class interpolators; wet-lab structures still the product.
questions.fsot: Genetics freeze 2026-08-17 quoted in the hub: product 0.13 Å vs AF 0.47 Å vs cryo-EM FSC ~1.2 Å vs bulk ~13 Å — do not cross-cite. Engine stays Genetics. CASP/CAMEO blind is OPEN (docs/CASP_CAMEO_BLIND_PROTOCOL.md). Zebrafish 0.358% stays inside 0.5%.

questions.question: Is a market a different medium from a neural net?
questions.community: Econophysics vs institutional economics.
questions.fsot: As-above-so-below. Same World Bank YoY on Economics and Neuroscience folds; |S_E/S_N| vs 5/4. Siloed 0.129% panel is not retuned.

questions.question: Are coastal water levels only astronomical harmonics, or a fluid pressure cell?
questions.community: NOAA CO-OPS harmonics are the operational standard; storm surge is added statistically.
questions.fsot: PRED-065 residual hold 0.030%. Dated 48 h surge windows (residual vs harmonic, threshold = POOF m) under PRED-064. Not a beat of the harmonic table at every minute.

questions.question: Can floods be windowed like earthquakes (pressure loads, then POOF)?
questions.community: USGS NWIS stage + NWS flood watches; hydrologic models are catchment-specific.
questions.fsot: PRED-078 two-sector valve (load bar = 1+POOF). Dated 7-day NWIS gage windows under PRED-064. Not street-level inundation.

questions.question: Can geomagnetic storms be issued as dated windows, not only Kp thresholds?
questions.community: SWPC Kp/Dst watches; coupling to F10.7 / IMF is statistical.
questions.fsot: Classifiers already solved (Q-SOL-02). New dated issues emit Kp≥5 72 h windows when the valve is loading (PRED-064). First issue 2026-08-25 locked quiet Kp<5 and stays frozen.

questions.question: Are chirp-mass and event-rate classes one compact-object fluid?
questions.community: GWTC catalogs; rates still model-dependent; siren H0 is sparse.
questions.fsot: PRED-067 chirp-mass class. PRED-077 siren H0 70.024 mid-sector — do not retune ρ onto SH0ES.

questions.question: Does FRB DM excess track the same bubble density as H0 sectors?
questions.community: IGM-only DM vs host/bubble excess still debated; CHIME catalog growing.
questions.fsot: FRBs are BH→WH orifice outgassing (PRED-084): repeaters = saloon-door post-POOF, one-shots = paper-rip. Energy = width×fluence vs e·POOF (37/37). Activity season T=5π+1/φ days vs FRB20180916B 16.35 d. 200·(1+sky_density) is REMEDIED_WRONG_APPLY (~66%, retired). PRED-052 keeps the 200 class. PRED-076 is angular grammar only.

questions.question: Is radius–period–insolation architecture one planetary fold?
questions.community: Formation channels (core accretion vs disk instability) still a zoo.
questions.fsot: PRED-066 architecture class hold. CAT-EXO 0.023%. Not one ε per planet.

questions.question: Is species-occurrence structure a second biosphere law?
questions.community: SDMs and occupancy models; no single counting law.
questions.fsot: PRED-068 occurrence-class hold (240 rec / 0.006%). Acoustic-ecology counting on D=15. Not a county arrival date.

questions.question: Are epidemic waves a different physics from other counting processes?
questions.community: Compartmental models (SIR/SEIR); wave timing remains hard.
questions.fsot: PRED-069 class hold (24 rec / 0.015%). Same POOF/SUCTION counting as GR b-value. Not a city outbreak date.

questions.question: Is ice-mass loss a seasonal valve on the same ocean/air fluid?
questions.community: GRACE/GRACE-FO mass; ice-sheet models vs observation still offset.
questions.fsot: PRED-080 GravIS |delta| APPLY residual (scalar median 0.023%). Decline classifier stays 100% match. Not a calving date.

questions.question: Is growing-season / yield class the same viscosity as ecology and hydrology?
questions.community: Agroecology field surveys and USDA yield models; season class is statistical, not a first-principles valve.
questions.fsot: PRED-081 season-class residual (276 rec / 0.018%) on D=16. Not county bushels next Tuesday.

questions.question: Is Gaia parallax / proper-motion structure a second astrometry law, or the same ladder-adjacent fold?
questions.community: Gaia DR3/DR4 reprocesses; distance-ladder papers often treat astrometry as a separate reduction.
questions.fsot: PRED-082 parallax class (deep 0.022%; CAT-GAIA-DR3 3459 / 0.022%). Not a new H0 from one star.

questions.question: Is millennial climate a different physics from the station-climate fluid (PRED-054)?
questions.community: GCM paleo surrogates vs ice-core reconstructions; millennial vs instrumental often siloed.
questions.fsot: PRED-083 millennial class on D=17 Atmospheric_Physics (20 rec / 0.006%). Distinct from PRED-054 NCEI. Not a named-year drought date.

questions.question: Are CKM/PMNS angles predicted or fitted SM inputs?
questions.community: CKM from global fits; PMNS from oscillation experiments; SM does not predict the mixings.
questions.fsot: PRED-070–075 promote V_ud, V_tb, δ_CKM, sin²θ12, sin²θ13, α_s(M_Z) from the Higgs/flavor layer. Kill = next PDG combination outside 0.5%.

questions.question: Can the model pick next-day prices or a crash date?
questions.community: EMH vs factor models; crash timing is not a solved forecast.
questions.fsot: Not claimed. World Bank YoY class residuals only. A ticker as a 0.5% central is a kill.

questions.question: Can the model predict an individual's diagnosis or onset date?
questions.community: Risk scores and trials; person-level onset remains clinical, not a ToE central.
questions.fsot: Not claimed. Immunology/cardiology class residuals and the 20.00 W observer lock only.
